link.title: Your link
link.shareText: I use Tyrex — take a look. Before buying, read the terms and risks.
link.qrHint: Let a friend scan this code with the phone camera — the link will open in Telegram.

how.title: How it works

step1.title: Share your link
step1.text: A friend opens Tyrex via your link and becomes your partner.

step2.title: The partner runs a card
step2.text: Your bonus depends on the card series: {{range}} per year of the card value.

step3.title: Rewards come once a day
step3.text: They're credited while both you and your partner have a working card. Claim them to your wallet at any time.

how.note: The bonus rate isn't guaranteed and may change. It's calculated in BTC and converted to dollars at the rate at the moment you claim.

list.title: Your partners
list.empty: No partners yet. Share your link with friends.

sheet.writeHint: The text will be copied — paste it in the chat.
sheet.noUsername: The partner has no Telegram username, so you can't write from here.

registered.friendly: Hi! I see you signed up in Tyrex. There's a free Mini card for subscribing to the channel — a good way to see how it works without spending anything. Ask me if anything is unclear.
registered.short: Hi! In Tyrex you can get a free Mini card for subscribing to the channel — try it.

gift.friendly: Hi! How's the gift card going? If you have questions about how cards and cycles work, I'm happy to explain. Read the terms before buying.
gift.short: Hi! How's the gift card? Ask if you have questions.

bought.friendly: Hi! I see you bought a card. Don't forget to start it — it only earns while it's working.
bought.short: Hi! Don't forget to start your card — it earns only while working.

working.friendly: Hi! Your card is working. If anything is unclear about cycles or withdrawals — write me.
working.short: Hi! Your card is working. Write if you have questions.
